answer: One concrete mechanism: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because umber only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, horizon is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any pigment approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
